title: Radiative transfer look-up tables for the GRS and hGRS atmospheric and sunglint correction processors (OPAC aerosols, wind-roughened sea surface), v3
description:
Look-up tables (LUTs) of radiative transfer simulations used by the atmospheric and sunglint correction processors GRS (Harmel et al., 2018; multispectral images: Sentinel-2, Landsat 8/9) and hGRS (hyperspectral images: EnMAP, PRISMA, EMIT, Hyperion, Tanager) over aquatic environments.

The simulations were computed with the vector radiative transfer model OSOAA (Chami et al., 2015) for a coupled atmosphere-ocean system with a wind-roughened sea surface, with six OPAC aerosol models.

Files

  • toa_lut_opac_wind_v3.nc (835 MB): normalized top-of-atmosphere radiance I (dimensions wind, model, aot_ref, wl, sza, vza, azi) and downwelling irradiance Ed, with the aerosol optical properties of each model (spectral aerosol optical thickness aot, single scattering albedo, asymmetry factor, extinction cross section...).
  • transmittance_lut_opac_wind_v3.nc (0.6 MB): total transmittance of the downward irradiance Ttot_Ed (dimensions wind, model, aot_ref, wl, sza).

Dimensions

  • wind: wind speed, 6 values from 0.5 to 16 m s-1
  • model: OPAC aerosol models ARCT_rh70, COAV_rh70, DESE_rh70, MACL_rh70, URBA_rh70, WASO_rh0
  • aot_ref: aerosol optical thickness at the reference wavelength (550 nm), 10 values from 0 to 1.5
  • wl: wavelength, 10 values from 0.35 to 2.5 µm
  • sza: solar zenith angle, 45 values from 0 to 88°
  • vza: viewing zenith angle, 34 values from 0 to 48.9°
  • azi: relative azimuth angle, 73 values from 0 to 360°

Use

Copy the files into the LUT folder of the processor: for hGRS, ~/.local/share/hgrs/lut on Linux (no configuration needed) or any folder set with hgrs_config --init /path/to/lut; for GRS, the grsdata folder of its configuration. The NetCDF files can be opened with xarray: xarray.open_dataset('toa_lut_opac_wind_v3.nc').
